rules.title: Sign the right surface
rules.body: Upright 9 signs the company. Use the food marks for projects and Kai or Sol for agents.

rules.title: Keep one type family
rules.body: Use Rethink Sans across product text. The B2 wordmark uses its outlined 760 master.

rules.title: Start with one palette
rules.body: Bind each UI color to a numbered primitive. Ink blue marks the main action on light surfaces. Use the lighter Slate role on dark surfaces.

rules.title: Group with space
rules.body: Align the first reading edge. Use 4 px within a field, 8 px between companion actions and 16–24 px between tasks.

rules.title: Name the action
rules.body: Use a short verb and its object. Say what happened in the past tense. Give a recovery the reader can perform.

rules.title: Move with the action
rules.body: Use a short press, settle the control at its current value, and respect the person’s reduced-motion preference.

companyLine: Every limit has a shelf life.
